subject: The editorial signal beside Bitscale's news triggers
body:
Bitscale's intent catalogue names 15 signals and the sources behind them: Google News and Bing News, company blogs, LinkedIn updates, PR Newswire, BusinessWire and Crunchbase. In our graph that editorial layer already has a measurable shape. Clay is named in 92 articles across 56 publications and Apollo in 102 across 88, while Databar and SyncGTM do not appear at all.

NewsletterFIT reads the newsletter ecosystem and returns extracted companies, people, topics and sponsor placements with the article and date behind each one, over REST and an MCP server, so it joins as one more source family rather than a new pipeline.

For a platform running 100+ sources, the question is which gap the next source closes. I can send a sample shaped the way your grid would join it.
